forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your work e-mail and we will send you a reset link.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. The link expires soon and works once.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.
reset.invalidLink: This reset link is missing or invalid. Request a new one.
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your Ecotech account.

password.title: Change password
password.subtitle: Confirm your current password, then choose a new one.
password.forced: You must change your password before continuing.
password.rules: At least 6 characters, including at least one letter.
password.signInAgain: Your password was changed and you were signed out everywhere. Sign in with the new password.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.required: Your role requires two-factor authentication. Turn it on to continue.
mfa.settingHint: Protect your account with an additional verification step: a one-time code e-mailed to you each time you sign in.
mfa.stateOn: Additional verification is required when signing in.
mfa.mandatoryNote: Your role requires it, so it stays on.
mfa.turnOffHint: Confirm your password to turn two-factor authentication off.
mfa.codeResent: A new code is on its way.
mfa.enabledNotice: Two-factor authentication is on. Signing in will now ask for an e-mailed code.
mfa.verifyHint: Enter the 6-digit code we just e-mailed you. It works once and expires in a few minutes.

notifications.title: Notification preferences
notifications.subtitle: Choose how you are told about each kind of event. In-app notifications are always on.
notifications.whatsappOff: WhatsApp delivery is not configured on this server yet.
notifications.pushUnsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
notifications.pushOff: Push notifications are not configured on this server yet.
notifications.pushEnabled: Push notifications enabled on this device.
notifications.pushDisabled: Push notifications disabled on this device.
notifications.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked in the browser settings.
notifications.pushFailed: Could not enable push notifications on this device.
